feedback: Judged before racing. The candidate is valid and changes only geometry.sensor_positions, moving all five sensors from y = 0.04 to y = 0.06 m. Controller values match iteration 4, the best raced design (kp 4.0, ki 0.3, kd 0.25, base_speed 1.3, score 74.19), and sensor x values and weights are unchanged. y = 0.06 is inside the contract limit of 0.08. The change isolates one variable. Iterations 0 to 4 all show max_error between 0.061 and 0.065 m on every track, whatever kp, ki, kd or base_speed were, so gain changes have not moved that floor. Earlier look-ahead is the untested hypothesis that could explain it. Iteration 4 also showed steering_oscillation at 0.254 on the oval, above the 0.2 concern level, so the next race should watch that closely. Do not treat the expected max_error drop or the oscillation outcome as established; neither has been measured for this candidate. After the race, decide from the telemetry. If max_error falls and line_loss_events drop while oscillation stays under about 0.2, keep y = 0.06 and then try base_speed toward 1.8 once progress nears 0.995 with no line loss. If the score falls below 74.19 or oscillation exceeds about 0.25, return to y = 0.04 and try kp 5 with kd 0.3, as iteration 3 suggested for the stiffer-gain route. Completion within 3 s is not expected at base_speed 1.3.
requested_changes: After the race, if max_error falls below about 0.058 m with oscillation under 0.2, keep geometry.sensor_positions at y 0.06 and raise controller.base_speed from 1.3 toward 1.8 once progress nears 0.995 with no line loss (iteration 4 gave no completions at base_speed 1.3).

If the score falls below 74.19 (iteration 4) or steering_oscillation exceeds about 0.25 on the oval, return geometry.sensor_positions to y 0.04 and try controller.kp 5.0 with controller.kd 0.3, since iteration 3 showed kp 4.0 with kd 0.2 raised oscillation to 0.21.

If max_error stays at 0.061 to 0.065 m despite the earlier look-ahead, the gain and sensor-y levers have both failed, so test a change to sensor_size (0.016) or sensor x spread before further gain tuning, because the off-track floor has not moved across iterations 0 to 4.
